bloques.titulo: Word in the past +)) can evoke a habit or a regular scene of the past.
texto: The tone is usually retrospective or nostalgic. It is not a rule that something always happens now; it distinguishes this use from a generalization.
In a child's life, he used to play a lot on the river.
(When summer came, we used to go to the sea in the family.)

frases.ja: こども の ころ、 よく かわ で あそんだ もの です。
frases.es: De niño solía jugar mucho en el río.
frases.en: When I was a kid, I used to play a lot on the river.

frases.ja: なつ に なる と、 かぞく で うみ へ いった もの です。
frases.es: Cuando llegaba el verano, solíamos ir al mar en familia.
frases.en: When the summer came, we used to go to the sea in the family.
